title: agrostemma nivale
intro: Agrostemma nivale, commonly known as sweet cicely, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia. It has been used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems, thanks to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostessa nivale include its expectorant, anti-catarrhal, and diuretic properties, which help in relieving coughs, colds, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, volatile oils, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
